Other markdown features, core tags and plugins meeting bbcode.

==== markdown-links

==== image-sizes
[center]![alt|200x100](https://example.com/a.png)[/center]
==== poll-in-center
[center]
[poll]
* [b]one[/b]
* two
[/poll]
[/center]
==== poll-around-tags
[poll]
* [color=red]red[/color]
* [plain][b][/plain]
[/poll]
==== details-in-center
[center]
[details="Summary"]
body [b]bold[/b]
[/details]
[/center]
==== center-in-details
[details="Summary"]
[center]centered[/center]
[/details]
==== wrap-with-tags
[wrap=box]
[center]x[/center]
[/wrap]
==== quote-with-attribution
[quote="system, post:1, topic:1"]
[center]x[/center] [b]y[/b]
[/quote]
==== nested-quotes
[quote]
outer [b]bold
[quote]
inner[/b]
[/quote]
[/quote]
==== fenced-code-with-language
```ruby
[b]x[/b] # not bold
```
==== fence-in-center

```
[b]x[/b]
```
[/center]
==== code-tag-with-language
[code=ruby]
puts "[b]x[/b]"
[/code]
==== math-inline

==== math-block
[center]
$$
x^2
$$
[/center]
==== table-with-tags

|---|---|

==== headings-markdown-and-tags
# [color=red]Title[/color]
## plain
[h1]Tag heading[/h1]
==== html-inline-with-tags

[b]x[/b]
</div>

***
[/center]

==== footnote-like
